name: Yacht Rock
description: Polished, jazz/R&B-inflected West Coast soft rock and blue-eyed soul from the late 1970s and early 1980s. Song fit matters more than artist name.

notes: This is a song-defined format. A qualifying artist can have many non-qualifying tracks.
Core songs are safe initial material. Related artists and artists with song rules are a controlled expansion layer.
Do not treat all soft rock, adult contemporary, disco, or 1970s pop as Yacht Rock.

sourceBasis.source: Poetics — A deep dive into the collaborative networks of Yacht Rock
sourceBasis.finding: Places the core scene in a connected Los Angeles studio ecosystem roughly from 1976 to 1984 and identifies its cross-genre musical roots.

sourceBasis.source: Spotify Newsroom — Yacht Rock history and sound
sourceBasis.finding: Describes the smooth late-1970s/early-1980s sound and its defining characteristics.

sourceBasis.source: Yacht or Nyacht / Beyond Yacht Rock ecosystem
sourceBasis.finding: Provides the most rigorous well-known song-by-song rather than artist-by-artist approach; disputed songs should stay out of the core until deliberately reviewed.

sourceBasis.source: Ultimate Classic Rock — Top Yacht Rock Songs
sourceBasis.finding: Independent editorial list used to cross-check enduring high-confidence songs and artists.

coreSongs: What You Won't Do for Love

excludedArtists.reason: Soft rock/AC, not automatic Yacht Rock.
Soft rock, generally too early and stylistically outside this format.

maintenanceNotes: For future additions, add a song to coreSongs only after it is cross-checked against multiple serious Yacht Rock sources.
Use an optional reviewedSongs section for debated material rather than relaxing the core rules.
A station-specific thumbs-down should blacklist only that song in Yacht Rock; it should not affect other Local Mixes.
